svg.data-rack-form: 2OU, Open Rack v3 (ORv3) tray; no four-post rack variant (guide Tables 2 and 6)
svg.data-port-count: 64 OSFP at up to 1600 Gbps and 2 SFP28 (guide Table 2)
svg.data-osfp-speeds: 1600G, 800G, 400G, 200G and 100G, by transceiver (guide, Interface Naming; Table 19)
svg.data-power-input-dc: 46 to 56 VDC from the ORv3 busbar, 110 A (guide Table 21)
svg.data-redundancy-note: three built-in 1600 W DC-to-DC bricks with no redundancy; a brick failure disables the optics (guide, DC-to-DC Power Bricks)
svg.data-cooling: 100 percent liquid-cooled; OAT PG 25 coolant through two UQDB06 plugs; no fans
svg.data-coolant-flow: 10 litres per minute, 25 to 40 PSI, coolant 7 to 45 C (guide Table 23)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 46 C (32 to 114.8 F) at sea level, 0 to 40 C up to 6000 ft (guide Table 5); recommended ambient 0 to 40 C with liquid cooling (Table 23)
svg.data-humidity: 10 to 90 percent noncondensing operating, 5 to 95 percent non-operating (guide Table 5)
svg.data-altitude: operating 6000 ft (1830 m); storage 15000 ft (4500 m) (guide Table 5)
svg.data-cpu: Intel 6-core 2.8 GHz Ice Lake D, 32 GB DRAM (guide Table 2)
svg.data-storage: two internal 200 GB NVMe SSDs (guide Table 2)
svg.data-optics-osfp: ORHS (OSFP with riding heat sink) transceivers, 1600G; see the Hardware Compatibility Tool (guide Table 19)
svg.data-optics-sfp28: ports 64 and 65 take 25G and 10G SFP28 transceivers (guide Table 19)
svg.data-leak-detection: leakage detection controller with the LEAKAGE lamp; the ON/OFF button restarts boot after a leak (guide, Leakage Detection)
svg.data-oob: one RJ-45 management port, 10 M, 100 M and 1 G (guide Table 20)
svg.data-console: one RJ-45 console port, shared between the CPU and the leakage detection controller board
svg.data-timing-outputs: one 1 PPS and one 10 MHz port on 2x1 DIN 1.0/2.3 latching connectors. The guide says they can be inputs or outputs. It also says the switch does not currently support timing features (guide, Connect 1-PPS and 10-MHz Timing Devices)
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15; ICES-003 / ICES-GEN; EN 55032; EN 55035; CISPR 32; CISPR 35; EN 300 386 V1.6.1 and V2.2.1; IEC/EN 61000-3-2 and 61000-3-3; AS/NZS CISPR 32; VCCI-CISPR 32; BSMI CNS 15936; KS C 9835, 9832 and 9610 (guide, Agency Approvals)
svg.data-seismic: tested for Zone 4 earthquake requirements to NEBS GR-63-CORE (guide Table 5)

g.data-description: Table 24 - red steady: a leak is detected and the alarm has been triggered; unlit: normal operation, no leak
g.title: led-leakage

g.data-description: Table 13 - blue blinking: the beacon feature is enabled (request chassis beacon fpc 0 on); unlit: not enabled
g.title: led-id

g.data-description: Table 13 - green blinking: loading Junos OS Evolved or shutting down; green steady: Junos OS Evolved is loaded; unlit: powered off or halted
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: Table 13 - red steady: a major fault; yellow steady: a minor fault; red and yellow blinking: a major and a minor fault with the device halted; unlit: halted or no alarm
g.title: led-alm
